This appendix provides the complete empirical ablation tables referenced in Chapters 2–4—covering the `nsa_flow` trade-off weight $w \in [0.01, 0.95]$, in-fold subject row-mean removal and deterministic ICA initialization, fine-grained quantile sparsity $q \in [\text{None}, 0.90]$, the `{python} N.sweep_n`-configuration `ADNI-MCI` grid sweep, synthetic per-regime breakdowns, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests against `PCA`—followed by computational complexity bounds.

## Effect of the Approximate Stiefel Weight $w \in [0.01, 0.95]$

@tbl-app-w-sweep and @fig-w-sweep evaluate `SiMLR` ($\mathbf{V}_m \ge 0, k = 3$) across ten values of $w \in [0.01, 0.95]$ on synthetic `NonnegParts` and clinical `ADNI-MCI` (`Protocol B`).

```{python}
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pysimlr.plotting import theme, VIEW_COLORS

csv_path = "results_cache/ablation_w_sweep.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    csv_path = "paper/results_cache/ablation_w_sweep.csv"

df_w = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

with theme():
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(13.6, 3.6), dpi=200, constrained_layout=True)
    ax1, ax2, ax3, ax4 = axes

    def _mark(ax, x, y, col, marker="o", label=None):
        ax.plot(x, y, "-", color=col, lw=2.0, label=label)
        ax.scatter(x, y, s=38, facecolor=col, edgecolor="#fcfcfb", linewidth=1.2, zorder=3, marker=marker)

    _mark(ax1, df_w["w"], df_w["Synth_Support_F1"], VIEW_COLORS[0])
    ax1.axvline(0.50, color="#898781", linestyle=":", lw=1.0)
    ax1.set_xlabel("Orthogonality weight w")
    ax1.set_ylabel("Support recovery F1 (↑)")
    ax1.set_title("A. Synthetic support F1")
    ax1.yaxis.grid(True)

    _mark(ax2, df_w["w"], df_w["Synth_Defect_D"], VIEW_COLORS[1], "s", label="NonnegParts")
    _mark(ax2, df_w["w"], df_w["ADNI_Defect_D"], VIEW_COLORS[0], "o", label="ADNI-MCI")
    ax2.set_yscale("log")
    ax2.axvline(0.50, color="#898781", linestyle=":", lw=1.0)
    ax2.set_xlabel("Orthogonality weight w")
    ax2.set_ylabel("Gram defect D(V) (log ↓)")
    ax2.set_title("B. Orthogonality defect")
    ax2.yaxis.grid(True)
    ax2.legend(loc="upper right")

    _mark(ax3, df_w["w"], df_w["ADNI_EffRank"], VIEW_COLORS[2], "^")
    ax3.axhline(3.0, color="#898781", lw=0.9)
    ax3.axvline(0.50, color="#898781", linestyle=":", lw=1.0)
    ax3.set_xlabel("Orthogonality weight w")
    ax3.set_ylabel("Effective rank (k = 3 ↑)")
    ax3.set_title("C. ADNI basis rank")
    ax3.yaxis.grid(True)

    _mark(ax4, df_w["w"], df_w["ADNI_CogPC1_R2"], VIEW_COLORS[0], "o")
    ax4.axvline(0.50, color="#898781", linestyle=":", lw=1.0)
    ax4.set_xlabel("Orthogonality weight w")
    ax4.set_ylabel("Held-out CogPC1 R² (↑)")
    ax4.set_title("D. ADNI predictive plateau")
    ax4.yaxis.grid(True)

    plt.show()
```

### Basis Health and Rank-Selection Stability Diagnostics on `ADNI-MCI`

To verify optimization conditioning and component identifiability directly on the four-view `ADNI-MCI` cohort (`Protocol B`), @fig-adni-basis-diagnostics applies `pysimlr.plot_basis_diagnostics` ($k = 3$, $q = 0.85$), reporting per-view effective rank against $k$, maximum column cosine overlap, $\log_{10}$ condition number, and achieved sparsity alongside the median `loading_margin`. @fig-adni-rank-selection applies `pysimlr.plot_rank_selection` to the 20-subsample `select_rank` evidence (`docs/audit/evidence/adni_rank_selection.csv`), contrasting non-negative estimation (`positivity="positive"`, where $k = 2$ clears the $0.90$ identification bar on all components while $k = 3$ exposes an under-identified Component 2 at $0.803$) against unconstrained signed estimation (`positivity="either"`, where no candidate $k \in \{2, 3, 4, 5\}$ clears $0.90$).

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Component stability across candidate ranks $k \\in \\{2, 3, 4, 5\\}$ (`pysimlr.plot_rank_selection`, 20 half-sample refits on `ADNI-MCI` from `docs/audit/evidence/adni_rank_selection.csv`). (A) Under non-negative estimation (`positivity='positive'`), $k = 2$ clears the $0.90$ identification bar across all components ($0.961, 0.997$), whereas at $k = 3$ the weakest component drops to $0.803$. (B) Under signed estimation (`positivity='either'`), no candidate $k$ clears $0.90$ across all components."
#| out-width: 100%
#| echo: false
import os
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pysimlr
from pysimlr.plotting import theme

_ars_p = "../docs/audit/evidence/adni_rank_selection.csv"
if not os.path.exists(_ars_p):
    _ars_p = "docs/audit/evidence/adni_rank_selection.csv"
_ars = pd.read_csv(_ars_p)

def _to_rank_res(pos_kind):
    sub = _ars[_ars["pos"] == pos_kind].sort_values("k")
    tbl = []
    chosen = None
    for _, r in sub.iterrows():
        st = [float(v) for v in str(r["component_stability"]).split()]
        ok = bool(r["all_stable"])
        if ok:
            chosen = int(r["k"])
        tbl.append({"k": int(r["k"]), "component_stability": st, "basis_degenerate": False})
    return {"criterion": "component", "k": chosen, "criteria": {"component": chosen}, "table": tbl}

with theme():
    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11.6, 4.4), dpi=200, constrained_layout=True)
    pysimlr.plot_rank_selection(_to_rank_res("positive"), ax=ax1)
    ax1.set_title("A. Non-negative (positivity='positive'): k = 2 identified")
    pysimlr.plot_rank_selection(_to_rank_res("either"), ax=ax2)
    ax2.set_title("B. Signed (positivity='either'): no k passes 0.90")
    plt.show()
```

## Preprocessing Controls: Subject Row-Mean Removal, ICA Initialization, and Orthogonal Varimax Rotation

On neuroimaging cohorts where cortical regions share a positive global correlation floor, @tbl-app-rowmean-ica and @fig-rowmean-k-ablation compare column centering with in-fold subject row-mean centering, PCA with deterministic FastICA [@hyvarinen2000independent] initialization, signed with non-negative bases, and the initializer alone with the fitted model (`SiMLR`, $k = 3$, $w = 0.50$, no Varimax, no quantile threshold; `scripts/paper_adni_ablations.py`). Row-mean centering applies to the three MRI views only; the eleven cognitive scales are on different units, and subtracting each subject's mean across them would remove overall severity from the outcome. With non-negative bases, row-mean centering changes cortical sparsity from `{python} N.rm_col_pca_pos_sp` to `{python} N.rm_row_pca_pos_sp` and `CogPC1` $R^2$ from `{python} N.rm_col_pca_pos_r2` to `{python} N.rm_row_pca_pos_r2`. Varimax rotation on column-centered data gives `{python} N.fl_varimax_simr_sp` sparsity on the 62 DKT regions with `{python} N.fl_varimax_simr_active` active regions per component, against `{python} N.fl_col_pca_simr_sp` and `{python} N.fl_col_pca_simr_active` without rotation.

```{python}
#| out-width: 100%
#| echo: false
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pysimlr.plotting import theme, VIEW_COLORS

csv_k = "results_cache/ablation_k_sparsity_sweep.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_k):
    csv_k = "paper/results_cache/ablation_k_sparsity_sweep.csv"
df_k = pd.read_csv(csv_k)

# Bar heights from the caches: DKT (view 2) loadings of each regime.
import json
_fl_path = "results_cache/adni_mci_feature_loadings.json"
if not os.path.exists(_fl_path):
    _fl_path = "paper/results_cache/adni_mci_feature_loadings.json"
_fl = json.load(open(_fl_path))
_mats = [np.asarray(_fl["view2_col_pca_simr"]), np.asarray(_fl["view2_varimax_simr"]), None,
         np.asarray(_fl["view2_row_ica_simr"]), None]
_rm_csv = "results_cache/ablation_rowmean_ica_positivity.csv"
if not os.path.exists(_rm_csv):
    _rm_csv = "paper/results_cache/ablation_rowmean_ica_positivity.csv"
_rm = pd.read_csv(_rm_csv)
_row_pca = _rm[_rm.Preprocessing.str.startswith("Row") & (_rm.Init == "PCA") & _rm.Positivity.str.startswith("Non")
               & _rm.Stage.str.startswith("Bipartite")].iloc[0]
_q80 = _fl["Col-Centered + PCA + Non-Neg + Quantile (q=0.80)"]
v1_sp, v2k_sp = [], []
for i, m in enumerate(_mats):
    if m is not None:
        v1_sp.append(100 * float((np.abs(m[:, 0]) < 1e-6).mean()))
        v2k_sp.append(100 * float((np.abs(m[:, 1:]) < 1e-6).mean()))
    elif i == 2:   # row-mean + PCA: all three MRI views (no DKT-only cache)
        v1_sp.append(100 * float(_row_pca.sparsity_v1)); v2k_sp.append(100 * float(_row_pca.sparsity_v2_k))
    else:          # q = 0.80: all three MRI views
        v1_sp.append(100 * _q80["sparsity_v1"]); v2k_sp.append(100 * _q80["sparsity_v2_k"])

regimes = [
    "Col + PCA\n(varimax=F)",
    "Col + Varimax\n(q = None)",
    "Row + PCA\n(q = None)",
    "Row + ICA\n(q = None)",
    "Col, q = 0.80\n(default varimax)"
]

with theme():
    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11.8, 4.1), dpi=300, constrained_layout=True)

    x = np.arange(len(regimes))
    w = 0.36
    b1 = ax1.bar(x - w/2, v1_sp, w, label="Component 1 (v₁ Sparsity %)", color=VIEW_COLORS[0])
    b2 = ax1.bar(x + w/2, v2k_sp, w, label="Components 2..k (v₂..ₖ Sparsity %)", color=VIEW_COLORS[2])

    for bars in (b1, b2):
        for bar in bars:
            h = bar.get_height()
            ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, h + 1.4, f"{h:.1f}%", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7.0, color="#52514e")

    ax1.set_xticks(x)
    ax1.set_xticklabels(regimes, fontsize=8.3)
    ax1.set_ylim(0, 105)
    ax1.set_ylabel("Cortical Basis Sparsity % (↑)")
    ax1.set_title("A. Component 1 vs. Components 2..k Sparsity")
    ax1.grid(True, axis="y")
    ax1.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=8.0)

    # Panel B: Latent Rank k Sweep
    for prep_lbl, col, mk in [("Col-Centered (PCA Init)", VIEW_COLORS[0], "o-"), ("Row-Centered (ICA Init)", VIEW_COLORS[2], "s--")]:
        sub_k = df_k[df_k["Regime"] == prep_lbl]
        ax2.plot(sub_k["k"], sub_k["Sparsity_All"] * 100.0, mk, color=col, lw=1.9, markersize=6.0, label=f"{prep_lbl} All v₁..ₖ")
        ax2.plot(sub_k["k"], sub_k["Sparsity_v2_k"] * 100.0, ":", color=col, lw=1.6, markersize=4.8, label=f"{prep_lbl} v₂..ₖ Only")

    ax2.set_xticks([2, 3, 5, 8, 12])
    ax2.set_xticklabels(["k=2", "k=3", "k=5", "k=8", "k=12"], fontsize=8.5)
    ax2.set_ylim(0, 100)
    ax2.set_xlabel("Latent Embedding Rank k")
    ax2.set_ylabel("Unthresholded Sparsity % (↑)")
    ax2.set_title("B. Natural Non-Negative Sparsity vs. Rank k")
    ax2.grid(True)
    ax2.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=7.8)

    plt.show()
```

```{python}
import os
import pandas as pd
from tabulate import tabulate

csv_path = "results_cache/adni_mci_1214_grid_sweep.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    csv_path = "paper/results_cache/adni_mci_1214_grid_sweep.csv"

df_sw = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
df_sw["Model"] = df_sw["Model"].replace({"Flow-SiMLR-V": "Flow-SiMR-V"})
df_ok = df_sw[df_sw["Status"] == "ok"].copy()

best_per_model = df_ok.sort_values("CogPC1_R2", ascending=False).groupby("Model", as_index=False).first()
best_per_model = best_per_model.sort_values("CogPC1_R2", ascending=False)
stats_per_model = df_ok.groupby("Model").agg(n_runs=("CogPC1_R2", "count"), mean_r2=("CogPC1_R2", "mean"), std_r2=("CogPC1_R2", "std"))

rows = []
for _, r in best_per_model.iterrows():
    m = r["Model"]
    n_r = int(stats_per_model.loc[m, "n_runs"])
    m_r2 = stats_per_model.loc[m, "mean_r2"]
    s_r2 = stats_per_model.loc[m, "std_r2"]
    mean_str = f"{m_r2:.3f} ± {s_r2:.3f}" if pd.notnull(s_r2) else f"{m_r2:.3f}"
    rows.append([
        r["Family"],
        m,
        n_r,
        f"{r['CogPC1_R2']:.4f}",
        f"{r['Mean11_RidgeCV']:.4f}",
        mean_str,
        f"{r['Runtime_s']:.2f}s"
    ])

headers = ["Family", "Model", "Runs", "Peak CogPC1 R2 ↑", "11-Scale R2 ↑", "Sweep Mean ± SD ↑", "Time ↓"]
print(tabulate(rows, headers=headers, tablefmt="pipe"))
```

## Synthetic Per-Regime Breakdown and Pairwise Wilcoxon Tests

@tbl-app-synthetic-breakdown and @fig-cmc-recovery report the 3-seed performance across each of the six synthetic ground-truth regimes, and @tbl-app-wilcoxon reports Wilcoxon signed-rank tests of each model against `PCA` over the 12 datasets, with seeds averaged within each dataset and Holm adjustment across models.

```{python}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| label: tbl-app-synthetic-breakdown
#| tbl-cap: "Out-of-sample performance across the six synthetic ground-truth regimes (`deep_ranking_benchmark.csv`). Entries show `Linear XV R2 (CMC or Support F1)`."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import os
import pandas as pd
from tabulate import tabulate

csv_path = "results_cache/deep_ranking_benchmark.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    csv_path = "paper/results_cache/deep_ranking_benchmark.csv"

df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
df["Model"] = df["Model"].replace({"Flow-SiMLR-V": "Flow-SiMR-V", "Flow-SiMLR": "Flow-SiMR"})

models = ["LEND", "Flow-SiMR-V", "SiMLR", "NSAFlow-PCA", "PCA", "NEDPP", "NED"]
syn_dsets = ["Linear", "Polynomial", "Sine", "Shared+Private", "NonnegParts", "NonnegPartsWeak"]

rows = []
for m in models:
    row = [m]
    for ds in syn_dsets:
        sub = df[(df["Dataset"] == ds) & (df["Model"] == m)]
        xv_m = sub["Strictly_Linear_Metric"].mean()
        if ds in ("NonnegParts", "NonnegPartsWeak"):
            s_m = sub["Support_Recovery_V"].mean()
            row.append(f"{xv_m:.3f} (F1={s_m:.2f})")
        else:
            c_m = sub["CMC_Latent_U"].mean()
            row.append(f"{xv_m:.3f} (CMC={c_m:.2f})")
    rows.append(row)

headers = ["Model", "Linear", "Polynomial", "Sine", "Shared+Priv", "NonnegParts", "NonnegWeak"]
print(tabulate(rows, headers=headers, tablefmt="pipe"))
```

Wins/ties/losses count datasets; $p$ is the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test, Holm-adjusted across the six models of each column (`deep_ranking.wilcoxon_vs_reference`)."
```{python}
#| echo: false
```

```{python}
import os
import pandas as pd
from tabulate import tabulate
from pysimlr.benchmarks.deep_ranking import wilcoxon_vs_reference

csv_path = "results_cache/deep_ranking_benchmark.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    csv_path = "paper/results_cache/deep_ranking_benchmark.csv"

df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
df["Model"] = df["Model"].replace({"Flow-SiMLR-V": "Flow-SiMR-V", "Flow-SiMLR": "Flow-SiMR"})
models = ["LEND", "NEDPP", "Flow-SiMR-V", "NED", "SiMLR", "NSAFlow-PCA"]
xv = wilcoxon_vs_reference(df, "Strictly_Linear_Metric", "PCA", models=models).set_index("Model")
u = wilcoxon_vs_reference(df, "Predictive_Metric", "PCA", models=models).set_index("Model")

rows = []
for m in models:
    a, b = xv.loc[m], u.loc[m]
    rows.append([m, f"{a.Wins} / {a.Ties} / {a.Losses}", f"{a.Mean_Diff:+.4f}", f"{a.P_Holm:.3f}",
                 f"{b.Wins} / {b.Ties} / {b.Losses}", f"{b.Mean_Diff:+.4f}", f"{b.P_Holm:.3f}"])
headers = ["Model vs PCA", "XV W/T/L (of 12)", "XV Mean Δ ↑", "XV p (Holm)",
           "U W/T/L (of 12)", "U Mean Δ ↑", "U p (Holm)"]
print(tabulate(rows, headers=headers, tablefmt="pipe"))
```

## Computational Complexity Summary

| Operation | Complexity per Iteration | Memory Footprint | Inner-Loop Factorization Required? |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **`nsa_flow` Retraction Step** | $\mathcal{O}(p_m k^2)$ | $\mathcal{O}(p_m k + k^2)$ | None (1 Gram product + 2 $[p_m,k]\times[k,k]$ products) |
| **Polar Consensus Update ($\mathbf{U}$)** | $\mathcal{O}(N k^2 + k^3)$ | $\mathcal{O}(N k)$ | $k \times k$ Sylvester polar factor ($k \ll N$) |
| **Forward / Backward Pass** | $\mathcal{O}(N p_m k)$ | $\mathcal{O}(N k + p_m k)$ | None |

: Computational and memory complexity of the `SiMR` and `nsa_flow` primitives. {#tbl-app-complexity}
